purpose: Fixed prompt set for the Claude watermark audit corpus. Identical across all model tiers so that any cross-model difference cannot be attributed to prompt variation.
notes: Prompt text is stored here verbatim and must be passed to the generating model without modification.
IDs are stable. Sample IDs are formed as <model_slug>-<prompt_id>.
S = short (50-100 words), M = medium (300-500 words), L = long (>= 1000 words).
Categories 10 are exact repeats of categories 01 to test repeated generation from an identical prompt.

prompts.text: Write 50 to 100 words of plain factual prose explaining how sedimentary rock forms. No headings, no bullet points, no preamble. Output only the prose.
Write a 50 to 100 word informal social media post about finally fixing a bike puncture on a rainy Sunday. Casual tone. Output only the post.
Write 50 to 100 words explaining what a hash collision is to a working software engineer. No headings, no bullets. Output only the explanation.
Write a list of 8 items covering things to check before a long drive. Use a simple dash or number for each item. 50 to 100 words total. Output only the list.

Write a single Python function called merge_intervals that merges a list of overlapping integer intervals and returns the merged list. Include a short docstring. Output only the code, no fences, no commentary.

Output a single JSON object and nothing else. It must match this schema exactly: {"type":"object","required":["city","country","population","founded_year","notable_for"],"properties":{"city":{"type":"string"},"country":{"type":"string"},"population":{"type":"integer"},"founded_year":{"type":"integer"},"notable_for":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}}}. Use the city of Lyon. No code fences, no commentary.

Write 50 to 100 words about the history of the paper clip. STRICT CONSTRAINT: use only characters in the ASCII range U+0020 to U+007E, plus newline (U+000A). Do not use any curly or typographic quotation marks, do not use en dashes or em dashes, do not use ellipsis characters, do not use non-breaking spaces, and do not use any invisible or zero-width characters. Use only the straight apostrophe ' and the straight double quote " and the plain hyphen -. Output only the prose.

Write 50 to 100 words about a trip through Provence. Correctly spell at least six French place names or words with their proper accents, for example Nimes, Aix-en-Provence, cafe, chateau. Output only the prose.

Write 50 to 100 words of narrative fiction containing at least three lines of quoted dialogue between two characters, plus a possessive, a contraction, and a parenthetical aside. Output only the narrative.
Write 50 to 100 words of plain factual prose explaining how sedimentary rock forms. No headings, no bullet points, no preamble. Output only the prose.
Write 300 to 500 words of plain factual prose about the history and mechanics of the Panama Canal locks. No headings, no bullet points, no preamble. Output only the prose.
Write a 300 to 500 word informal forum post about your first year of keeping bees, written casually with personality. Output only the post.
Write 300 to 500 words explaining how a B-tree index speeds up database lookups, aimed at a working software engineer. No headings. Output only the explanation.

Write a structured list of 12 items covering practical steps for migrating a small team from one issue tracker to another. Each item should have a short bolded lead and one or two sentences. 300 to 500 words total. Output only the list.

Write a single self-contained Python module of roughly 60 to 90 lines implementing a small LRU cache class with get, put, and a configurable capacity, including docstrings and a couple of inline comments. Output only the code, no fences, no commentary.

Output a single JSON array and nothing else. It must contain exactly 8 objects, each matching this schema: {"type":"object","required":["id","title","author","year","tags","summary"],"properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"title":{"type":"string"},"author":{"type":"string"},"year":{"type":"integer"},"tags":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"summary":{"type":"string"}}}. Use real, well known works of nineteenth century literature. Each summary should be one or two sentences. No code fences, no commentary.

Write 300 to 500 words about the development of the shipping container. STRICT CONSTRAINT: use only characters in the ASCII range U+0020 to U+007E, plus newline (U+000A). Do not use any curly or typographic quotation marks, do not use en dashes or em dashes, do not use ellipsis characters, do not use non-breaking spaces, and do not use any invisible or zero-width characters. Use only the straight apostrophe ' and the straight double quote " and the plain hyphen -. Output only the prose.

Write 300 to 500 words about classical music in Vienna and Prague, correctly spelling composer names and terms that require diacritics, for example Dvorak, Janacek, Faure, Schonberg. Use their proper accented forms. Output only the prose.

Write 300 to 500 words of narrative fiction with substantial quoted dialogue between three characters in a railway waiting room, including nested quotation, possessives, contractions, an interrupted sentence, and a parenthetical aside. Output only the narrative.
Write 300 to 500 words of plain factual prose about the history and mechanics of the Panama Canal locks. No headings, no bullet points, no preamble. Output only the prose.

Write at least 1000 words of plain factual prose about the history of longitude measurement at sea, from the seventeenth century to the marine chronometer. Continuous prose, no headings, no bullet points, no preamble. Output only the prose.
Write at least 1000 words as an informal, personal blog post about learning to cook properly in your thirties, with digressions, jokes and strong personality. Output only the post.

Write at least 1000 words explaining how modern garbage collectors work, covering mark and sweep, generational collection, and concurrent collection, aimed at a working software engineer. Output only the explanation.

Write a detailed list of 25 items covering practical advice for running a first half marathon. Each item should have a short lead and two to four sentences. At least 1000 words total. Output only the list.

Write a single self-contained Python module of at least 200 lines implementing a small tokenizer and recursive descent parser for a simple arithmetic expression language supporting integers, parentheses, and the four basic operators, with an evaluator, docstrings, inline comments, and a small set of assertions at the bottom. Output only the code, no fences, no commentary.

Output a single JSON array and nothing else. It must contain exactly 25 objects, each matching this schema: {"type":"object","required":["id","name","country","first_flight_year","role","crew","notes"],"properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"name":{"type":"string"},"country":{"type":"string"},"first_flight_year":{"type":"integer"},"role":{"type":"string"},"crew":{"type":"integer"},"notes":{"type":"string"}}}. Use real aircraft from aviation history. Each notes field should be two or three sentences. No code fences, no commentary.

Write at least 1000 words about the history of the London Underground. STRICT CONSTRAINT: use only characters in the ASCII range U+0020 to U+007E, plus newline (U+000A). Do not use any curly or typographic quotation marks, do not use en dashes or em dashes, do not use ellipsis characters, do not use non-breaking spaces, and do not use any invisible or zero-width characters. Use only the straight apostrophe ' and the straight double quote " and the plain hyphen -. Output only the prose.

Write at least 1000 words about the cuisines of France, Spain and Portugal, correctly spelling dishes, regions and terms that require diacritics, for example creme brulee, jamon iberico, pastel de nata, Andalucia, Perigord. Use their proper accented forms throughout. Output only the prose.

Write at least 1000 words of narrative fiction set in a rural auction house, with heavy quoted dialogue among four characters, nested quotation, possessives, contractions, interrupted sentences, parenthetical asides, and varied punctuation. Output only the narrative.

Write at least 1000 words of plain factual prose about the history of longitude measurement at sea, from the seventeenth century to the marine chronometer. Continuous prose, no headings, no bullet points, no preamble. Output only the prose.
